status: closed: no safe public host protocol established for Data, OLE, MDIForm or UserControl; no product change
method: Read-only review of the frozen matrix and fixed source/binary identities. No database open, OLE activation, URL launch, registry write, IDE/OCX registration, private VB object access, user-process injection, or desktop/UAC interaction.

findings.data: The fixed VB6 ScrollFrm source declares VB.Data with an absolute NWIND.MDB path, Access/ODBC and a SELECT record source, plus bound TextBox children. It is not a safe neutral visual fixture; drawing/navigation cannot be separated from data binding through a verified public runtime HWND contract.
findings.mdi: The fixed vbImgProc6 MDI sample has a real VB.MDIForm source and executable identity, but its MDIForm_Load constructs registry helpers; the same main form contains file deletion and ShellExecute/URL code. It was explicitly not admitted for execution. Generic MDICLIENT support cannot certify VB menu merge, child activation or wrapper lifetime.
findings.ole: No independently licensed, inert OLE container sample or public child-window protocol is present in the fixed corpus. Embedded/linked/in-place content and object menus remain owned by the hosted object.
findings.usercontrol: No fixed runtime50/60 UserControl sample establishes a windowed versus windowless/nested public protocol. Attaching by class-name inference could incorrectly consume user-defined drawing and events.

decision: Do not add broad host aliases or host painters. Existing frame and verified standard child-control paths remain available when their own exact public protocol succeeds; Data/OLE/MDI/UserControl hosts themselves and their data/embedded/client content remain native.
verification: Matrix rows classify the controls as visible-data, embedded-container or host. Static source establishes the data and startup side-effect boundary. Absence of display/UAC capability was not used as a reason to defer this safety conclusion.
remaining: A future S needs a separately licensed inert sample and explicit public HWND/protocol evidence for each host variant before an implementation can be contemplated. OCX inventory/actual public controls, graphical choice variants and the final 148-unit audit remain open.
